entries.description: Then Anuruddha went to Nandiya and Kimbila
entries.subject: Then Anuruddha

spans.text: Atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yenāyasmā ca nandiyo yenāyasmā ca kimilo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantañca nandiyaṁ āyasmantañca kimilaṁ etadavoca: Then Anuruddha went to Nandiya and Kimbila, and said to them, “Khamanīyaṁ bhagavā, yāpanīyaṁ bhagavā, na ca mayaṁ, bhante, piṇḍakena kilamāmā”ti.

entries.description: bowed and sat down to one side
entries.subject: bowed and

spans.text: Those venerables bowed and sat down to one side.
Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ anuruddhaṁ bhagavā etadavoca: The Buddha said to Anuruddha, “kacci vo, anuruddhā, khamanīyaṁ, kacci yāpanīyaṁ, kacci piṇḍakena na kilamathā”ti?

And the venerables Nandiya and Kimbila spoke likewise, and they added: āyasmāpi kho kimilo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: “mayhampi kho, bhante, evaṁ hoti: ‘lābhā vata me, suladdhaṁ vata me yohaṁ evarūpehi sabrahmacārīhi saddhiṁ viharāmī’ti.

spans.text: Before my awakening—when I was still unawakened but intent on awakening—I too perceived light and vision of forms.
